root_cause_short: SocketGateway accepted external swapExtraData; attacker triggered transferFrom exploiting approvals. Zero-native-balance-delta bypassed the sanity check.
exploit_steps: Attacker crafted swapExtraData triggering transferFrom against user approvals
Balance check verified native token delta but missed approved ERC-20 siphoning
Contract executed payload, transferring 0 WETH while draining other approved assets
invariant_broken: Post-execution balance checks must cover all token types reachable via arbitrary calldata, not only native amounts.
prerequisites: Users with active approvals to SocketGateway
mitigation_class: Comprehensive Post-Call Invariant Checks
notes: Same arbitrary-call-against-approvals pattern as Li.Fi Jul 2024 and SwapNet/Aperture Jan 2026.
reconciliation_notes: Exact date unknown in Gemini output ('January 2024'); estimated 2024-01-16. Sources empty — needs enrichment.

root_cause_short: CauldronV4 repayForAll reduced totalBorrowAssets without proportionally reducing totalBorrowShares, enabling share inflation via 1-wei rounding loops.
exploit_steps: Flash loan MIM and deposit into BentoBox
Call repayForAll to skew asset-to-share ratio to ~1:26
Loop borrowing 1 wei of assets and repaying 1 wei of shares to inflate total shares exponentially
Borrow entire protocol liquidity from secondary account against minimal collateral
invariant_broken: A reduction in total borrow assets must yield an exactly proportional reduction in total borrow shares.
mitigation_class: Proportional Share Accounting and Rounding Checks
notes: Forced temporary depeg of MIM stablecoin.
reconciliation_notes: Halborn URL slug says 'october-2025' for a Feb 2024 incident — stale slug or republication. Abracadabra also had a separate incident in Mar 2024; verify this is the Feb 5 one.

root_cause_short: Attacker added own address to authorized minter list via weak access control, enabling unauthorized minting of 1.79B PLA tokens.
exploit_steps: Attacker bypassed access control to append own address as authorized minter
Minted 200M PLA tokens (~$36.5M)
After failed negotiations, minted an additional 1.59B PLA (~$253.9M)
Dumped tokens on centralized exchanges
invariant_broken: Administrative roles such as minter must only be appended via heavily secured multi-signature governance with a timelock.
prerequisites: Vulnerable authorization modifier on minter-role function
mitigation_class: OpenZeppelin AccessControl and Timelocks
notes: Market value destroyed; protocol forced token migration.
reconciliation_notes: $290M is face-value notional at mint; realized drainage on exchange dumps was substantially lower. Reconcile to realized USD if possible.

root_cause_short: Attacker gained unauthorized access to operational private keys, draining exchange reserves.
exploit_steps: Compromised FixedFloat backend infrastructure
Extracted private keys for BTC and ETH hot wallets
Transferred 400 BTC and 1,700 ETH
Exchange placed into maintenance mode post-drain
invariant_broken: Operational private keys must be inaccessible from external network interfaces.
mitigation_class: Hardware Security Modules (HSM)
notes: Non-KYC anonymous exchange; team initially framed outflows as 'minor technical problems'.

root_cause_short: Rogue developer (suspected DPRK front) planted vulnerabilities prior to deployment and later exploited them.
exploit_steps: Developer implanted backdoor logic during initial contract development
Protocol launched without independent audit catching the backdoor
Developer triggered exploit, draining $62.5M
Funds returned without ransom after public pressure
invariant_broken: Protocol deployment must be preceded by independent third-party audits capable of detecting intentionally malicious execution paths, not only bugs.
prerequisites: Trusted insider with contract authorship access
mitigation_class: Mandatory Independent Audits and Multi-Party Code Review
notes: Full recovery post-negotiation. Suspected Lazarus-style dev infiltration.
reconciliation_notes: Exact date unclear — Gemini said 'March 2024'; estimated 2024-03-26. Sources missing.

root_cause_short: Upgrade shifted storage layout, causing `initialized` variable to read as false; allowed attacker to re-initialize and hijack contract.
exploit_steps: First exploit: manipulated unvalidated CCTP receiver addresses to drain USDC
Developers deployed flawed patch altering memory layout
Second exploit: attacker read contract as uninitialized due to slot shift
Called initialization functions, granting self admin rights
Upgraded contract maliciously and drained remaining funds
invariant_broken: Storage slot variables must remain strictly aligned and immutable across proxy upgrades.
prerequisites: Flawed contract upgrade altering storage layout
mitigation_class: Storage Layout Verification (storage-gap pattern, upgrade simulators)
notes: Two-part: the security patch itself introduced the catastrophic secondary vulnerability. Textbook 'patch-worse-than-bug'.

root_cause_short: EVM integer truncation allowed attacker to redeem underlying assets with fewer receipt tokens due to artificially inflated exchange rate in empty market.
exploit_steps: Minted 2 wei of soVELO in newly created market
Donated ~35.47M VELO directly to contract, inflating exchangeRate
Borrowed WETH against inflated collateral valuation
Called redeemUnderlying; division truncation yielded cost of 1 wei instead of 2 wei
Looped redemption across multiple markets
invariant_broken: Redeemed underlying tokens must strictly match proportionate value of burned receipt tokens without precision truncation loss.
mitigation_class: Minimum Liquidity Minting (Dead Shares)
notes: Known Compound V2 fork vulnerability class; exchange rate manipulation in empty market.

root_cause_short: Poor access controls on a privileged account allowed mint of 5B GALA tokens.
exploit_steps: Compromised (or insider-controlled) administrative account with mint privileges
Minted 5 billion GALA tokens worth ~$22M
Founder publicly acknowledged internal controls failure
invariant_broken: Token supply expansion must require multi-signature governance resistant to single-account compromise.
prerequisites: Compromise or insider control of privileged account
mitigation_class: Multisig Minter Roles and Timelocks
notes: Scope boundary case between access-control exploit and insider threat.
reconciliation_notes: Exact date missing — Gemini said 'May 2024'; estimated 2024-05-20. Sources empty.

root_cause_short: Unauthorized access to highly privileged custodial private keys enabled mass UTXO transfers.
exploit_steps: Attacker gained access to custodial private keys
Initiated unauthorized transfers of 4,502.9 BTC
Dispersed funds across hundreds of addresses to evade tracking
invariant_broken: Custodial cold/hot wallet boundaries must strictly prevent unauthorized mass UTXO transfers.
mitigation_class: Institutional Cold Storage and HSM-backed Signing
notes: Largest crypto theft of 2024; exact vector obfuscated by institutional silence.

root_cause_short: sUSDePriceProvider medianized 11 sources; 5 of them relied on Curve get_p spot price, so flash-loan induced intra-block manipulation pulled the median.
exploit_steps: Flash loan massive liquidity
Dump USDE in Curve pools to suppress sUSDE spot price via get_p
Borrow sUSDE at suppressed valuation
Reverse swap in Curve to inflate sUSDE price
Liquidate own borrowing position at inflated collateral value to extract uWETH
invariant_broken: Asset price valuation must remain resistant to intra-block flash-loan manipulation; medianizing spot sources is not sufficient.
prerequisites: Oracle reliance on unmitigated spot prices
mitigation_class: TWAP Integration; Cross-Venue Sanity Checks
notes: Protocol suffered a secondary attack days later by the same exploiter. Key lesson: medianizing across correlated spot sources does not defend against flash loans.

root_cause_short: Unauthorized access to hot wallet infrastructure enabled mass automated withdrawals across 10 cryptocurrencies on 7 chains.
exploit_steps: Attackers breached the internal network securing BtcTurk hot wallets
Extracted private keys for hot wallets across 7 blockchains
Broadcast transactions draining $55M in various assets
Consolidated stolen funds into off-exchange accounts
invariant_broken: Hot wallet transaction limits must prevent total depletion of operational liquidity by unauthorized actors.
mitigation_class: Strict Rate Limiting and Automated Anomaly Freezes
notes: Binance assisted in freezing $5.3M.
reconciliation_notes: Halborn URL slug says 'august-2025' for a June 2024 incident — stale slug. Verify primary date is correct.

root_cause_short: depositToGasZipERC20 accepted user-provided swapData without validation, executing arbitrary transferFrom against user approvals.
exploit_steps: Identified users with infinite approvals to Li.Fi bridge
Crafted malicious calldata containing transferFrom instructions
Passed payload into depositToGasZipERC20
Contract executed arbitrary call, transferring approved tokens to attacker
153 wallets drained
invariant_broken: User-provided calldata must not execute unauthorized state changes or token transfers on behalf of the contract.
prerequisites: Users with active infinite approvals to protocol router
mitigation_class: Strict Calldata Whitelisting and Target Address Verification
notes: Users forced to revoke approvals via revoke.cash. AMLBot clustering later linked this attacker to 2026 SwapNet/Aperture campaign.

root_cause_short: Compromise of a multisig threshold allowed unauthorized withdrawal of exchange reserves via valid signatures.
exploit_steps: Infected operational devices of WazirX multisig signers
Extracted private keys or manipulated payload signing
Broadcast malicious transactions draining Safe multisig
Laundered funds through decentralized mixers
invariant_broken: Multisig threshold signatures must strictly require non-compromised, independent signers.
prerequisites: Compromise of multiple independent key holders
mitigation_class: Geographic and Hardware Isolation of Signers
notes: Attributed to DPRK Lazarus Group; targeted Safe multisig on Ethereum.
reconciliation_notes: Sources missing from Gemini output — needs enrichment.

root_cause_short: Attacker ('Humpy' / goldCOMP) accumulated delegated voting power and passed Proposal 289 transferring 499,000 COMP (~5% of treasury) to attacker-controlled multisig.
exploit_steps: Attacker accumulated COMP and inflated delegation over time
Submitted Proposal 289 disguised as yield strategy
Exploited voter fatigue to pass narrowly (682K for / 633K against)
Proposal executed, 499K COMP transferred to goldCOMP multisig
invariant_broken: Treasury execution must be resistant to delegated governance takeovers; large transfers require supermajority and delay.
prerequisites: Low effective timelock on treasury actions
mitigation_class: Timelocks, Veto Powers, Quadratic/Conviction Voting
notes: Funds returned in negotiated settlement that also altered fee structures.
reconciliation_notes: Gemini framed this as 'flash-loan-assisted delegation'; most post-mortems describe primarily long-term accumulation, not flash-loan delegation. Reconcile the framing.

root_cause_short: Fake-job-offer malware extracted the private key controlling the proxy admin, enabling withdrawAdmin execution.
exploit_steps: Infected administrator machines via fake-job-offer social engineering
Extracted proxy admin private key
Upgraded proxy and called withdrawAdmin
Drained 32.5M NXRA tokens to attacker wallet
invariant_broken: Proxy contract ownership must require multi-signature consensus resistant to single-endpoint malware infection.
prerequisites: Compromise of proxy admin private key
mitigation_class: Multisig Ownership and Timelocks
notes: Fake-job-offer SE is a Lazarus signature.
reconciliation_notes: Loss amount: Gemini narrative says $1.5M; second source URL slug suggests $1.8M. Reconcile.

root_cause_short: batchHarvestMarketRewards lacked nonReentrant modifier, allowing malicious Pendle market to re-enter and inflate reward accounting.
exploit_steps: Deployed fraudulent Pendle market with malicious SY token
Flash-loaned assets and deposited them into the fake market
Called batchHarvestMarketRewards, triggering fake market's redeemRewards
Fake market re-entered Penpie via depositMarket, inflating balance
Penpie calculated inflated balance as legitimate rewards, paying out attacker
Attacker withdrew original deposit plus inflated rewards
invariant_broken: Reward accounting state must fully resolve before allowing external callbacks to alter vault balances.
prerequisites: Missing reentrancy guard on outer batch function
mitigation_class: CEI Pattern; nonReentrant Locks on All State-Mutating Entry Points
notes: Inner function had reentrancy guard; outer batch did not. Classic 'protected the wrong level' failure.

root_cause_short: mint() accepted native ETH without applying ETH/BTC exchange rate, minting uniBTC 1:1 with deposited ETH.
exploit_steps: Called mint() depositing native Ethereum
Contract scaled decimals but did not apply ETH/BTC exchange rate
Minted 1 uniBTC per 1 ETH
Swapped artificially acquired uniBTC for stable assets in AMMs
invariant_broken: Fiat value of deposited collateral must strictly equal or exceed fiat value of synthetic tokens minted.
mitigation_class: Oracle Price Feed Integration for All Collateral Types
notes: Executed across multiple L2 chains where uniBTC was deployed.

root_cause_short: INLETDRIFT malware intercepted RPCs, substituting benign maintenance transactions with malicious contract upgrades while spoofing the developer UI.
exploit_steps: Infected developer macOS devices via a malicious PDF delivered on Telegram
Developers initiated benign multisig transactions that simulated safely on Tenderly
Malware intercepted the RPC and substituted the payload with a malicious contract upgrade
Developers signed the malicious payload via hardware wallets, believing it matched the UI
Upgraded contract drained $53M from user pools
invariant_broken: Hardware wallet signatures must strictly correspond to the payload intended and displayed by the host interface.
mitigation_class: Independent Device Payload Decoding (e.g. Clear-Signing, Cosigner)
notes: DPRK Citrine Sleet / UNC4736 / AppleJeus cluster. SEAL 911 later linked same actor to Drift Apr 2026. Foundational case that hardware wallets are blind to UI-layer manipulation.

root_cause_short: Hardcoded roundId=2 in ChainlinkUniV2Adapter prevented historical TWAP check, forcing reliance on manipulated spot price.
exploit_steps: Flash loaned BOO from SpookySwap to drain liquidity
Deposited 1 BOO into Polter Finance as collateral
Hardcoded oracle adapter evaluated 1 BOO at ~$1.37 trillion via spot
Borrowed 9.1M wFTM against inflated collateral
Repaid flash loan to restore peg and exit
invariant_broken: Oracle price feeds must dynamically fetch historical data to validate spot-price integrity against extreme variance.
prerequisites: Hardcoded oracle parameters bypassing historical check
mitigation_class: Dynamic Oracle Round Parameterization; Reject Oracles with Hardcoded Rounds
notes: Protocol paused operations and filed police report.

root_cause_short: Insiders and sniper bots controlled 80-90% of supply at TGE; coordinated dump within 20 minutes of peak drained retail liquidity.
exploit_steps: Insiders and snipers acquired 80-90% of supply at token generation
Coordinated pump via celebrity marketing drove price to peak
Concentrated holders dumped within ~20 minutes, draining retail liquidity
invariant_broken: Token launches must enforce distribution invariants preventing majority insider/sniper capture at TGE.
mitigation_class: Launch Caps, Bonding Curves, Anti-Snipe Measures
notes: Boundary case between rug-pull and technical exploit. Included per our scope of 'rugs with a technical backdoor / distributional mechanic'.
reconciliation_notes: Exact date uncertain ('December 2024'); sources missing. Consider whether this meets the scope bar — purely social-layer, no smart-contract bug.

root_cause_short: Unauthorized extraction of multisig private keys allowed attackers to drain bridge reserves.
exploit_steps: Funded execution wallets via Tornado Cash
Compromised multisig private keys
Authorized fraudulent transactions transferring 26,741 ETH and millions in stablecoins
Dispersed assets to multiple untracked addresses
invariant_broken: Bridge vault assets must only be released upon cryptographic proof of corresponding lock/burn events on the origin chain.
mitigation_class: Decentralized Validator Networks; Threshold Signature Schemes
notes: Methodology suggests Lazarus. Out-of-bucket (Dec 31 2023) but bleeds into 2024 reporting; keeping for continuity.
reconciliation_notes: Date is 2023-12-31, technically outside 2024 bucket. Decide whether to keep or move to 2023 bucket when we get there.
